title: Renewables Lab: US transition investigation
assumptions: Six illustrative regions, hourly dispatch, capacity-limited hub links with explicit end-to-end losses and timed outages, energy-conserving demand shifts, empty starting storage, 88% round-trip storage efficiency. Not calibrated to the US grid; not a forecast.
